summary.intent: Finish and publish the camelCase fields PR (fix/camel-case-fields) while reviewing the result of a parallel 'error-envelope' agent that works on the callisto CLI's release/error envelope output.
summary.outcome: Linked trail 177 to the camelCase branch, found PR 498, dumped its diff, and had a courier agent draft the PR body. Reviewed the error-envelope agent's worktree, added a changeset (release-pending-envelope.md) and ran verify.sh. The PASS/FAIL results and final state aren't shown in the transcript.

repo: Callisto is a Rust workspace with crates callisto-cli and callisto-model; CLI behavior lives in crates/callisto-cli/src and the release report model in crates/callisto-model/src/release/report.rs.
Release contract changes are reflected in docs/specs/release.json and covered by contract tests (release_pending_contract_tests.rs, error_envelope_tests.rs).
User-facing changes require a changeset file in .changeset/ (e.g. release-pending-envelope.md).
Agent worktrees live under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id>/ in the repo, and a shared verify.sh script takes a worktree path and emits PASS/FAIL lines.
workflow: Parallel agents (SendMessage/Agent) can be used so that a PR description is written by a courier agent while the main session continues other work.
`entire trail link <id> --branch <b> --base main --json` links a trail to a branch; the PR number can then be looked up via `gh pr list --head <branch> --json number`.
Saving `gh pr diff` output to a temp file gives agents a stable artifact to base the PR body on.
The error-envelope agent found most of its work was already on main, so the review focused on a small remaining diff.

friction: A `sleep 3` was needed between trail link and PR lookup, suggesting PR creation/linking is asynchronous.
The error-envelope task overlapped with work already on main, wasting some agent effort.
open_items: Verify results from verify.sh on the error-envelope worktree were not captured, so the outcome needs confirmation.
The error-envelope branch still needs to be committed, pushed and turned into a PR if verification passes.
The PR 498 body drafted by the courier agent still needs to be applied/reviewed.
